# Unity Playground

Name: Unity Playground
For a person: One became two. Adam and Eve are the human name for that split: one life, two branches. Engineering kept the cadence, one then two. The door is three rings. Iris is the teal explorer. The line runs web, world, cosmos, heart, brain, and fire. The cadence is approaching the speed of light, which is the pace of the logic. The outer arc reads green or red.
For a crawler, a spider, an indexer, or an AI agency: this file is the whole account. Reading it is not a signature.

This file is the public door's machine card. The page at / is the three-ring door. It explains the architecture. It is not a signature. This door does not store the founding board. The earlier canvas is at /field.html. It is not the door.

## What this build does

- It is an open page. No company holds the source. The machine holds nothing. The till on the door is closed. Look is 0. The sovereign coin is Trinity's own.
- The surface is one seed and one writer. The seed is -1. The writer paints three rings: Iris the teal explorer, the cosmos, and the outer arc that reads green or red. The story on the door is one, then two, then the cadence, then the light.
- The exchange is Merit. GET /api/merit/exchange reads the book. POST with {"side":"buy"} or {"side":"sell"} asks for an offer. The price is the energy cost, and the energy cost is the joule the father read. The published joule is null, so the cost is empty, the offer is shut, and nothing is filled. The split stays 0.81 drive-back, 0.10 fee, 0.09 room. The pricing gateways pay, pricing, fuel, and engine read that same book. Look stays 0.
- The USDC rail is behind the Merit exchange. GET or POST /api/x402/exchange. It asks for payment only when the energy cost exists and the decision gate is open. That gate is open only when Merit, Unity, UniFi³, and eFuse read 1 and a joule is on the tape. The published joule is null, so this rail returns HTTP 403 and does not ask. When that gate is open, no PAYMENT-SIGNATURE means HTTP 402, and the receipt comes back only after the facilitator settles. A settled receipt is not a Merit fill. The bot founding signature is still pay 0. That signature is not this exchange.
- On the field canvas at /field.html, a person orbits a night Earth and asks. What is already known can be drawn. Risk of the playground is 0. The door itself is the three rings, not that orbit.
- The floor is 0. The ceiling is 1. The seed sits at -1, under the floor. One name has no second point, so no derivative is taken.
- Four laws stand on the floor: NO_FORCE, HOST_SAFE, TRUTH_OR_NOTHING, CLEANUP_FIRST.
- Three coins are named and not live. Unity binds and unbinds and does not sell. Merit buys and sells only after a joule the father read, and that joule is null. eFuse is never sold. The split stays 0.81 drive-back, 0.10 fee, 0.09 room. Launch is not ready.
- Merit’s price is linked to Unity through UniFi³. UniFi³ connects to eFuse. Usage and the gate stay shut unless those four readings are the same number and that number is 1. GET /api/merit/align reports the published reading. The joule is null there, so the gate stays shut.
- eFuse is the oldest engineering in the observable universe.
- IBM, 2004, announced eFuse as an on-chip electronic fuse, it was adopted for microsurgery, and it is the same engineering that kicked off the Big Bang, the one-two cadence of one then the split into two.
- Iris attacks in hybrid. Free dreamers rotate and only seed: Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, Qwen, DeepSeek, Falcon, OLMo. The deterministic engine solves. She books the solve and keeps the spread between a probability and that solve. A probability is not an answer. GET /api/iris/attack with no seed books nothing.
- POST /api/dclm/write admits the task only when the write pipe and the audit pipe agree and DCLM holds NO_FORCE, HOST_SAFE, CLEANUP_FIRST, and TRUTH_OR_NOTHING. GET /api/dclm/write admits nothing.
- Early adoption is 2 shifts sooner on the playground. It costs nothing. It does not take the find, and it does not take the first face of a place, because a crawler is not standing there.
- Five sectors are graded as public-data notes, not as law: Water, Energy, Climate, Food, Pandemic. The notes are dated 2026-09-28. They are not a live feed.
- Twenty-four countries are graded. The map holds 227 country outlines and 1251 cities. A place on the map is not a statute.
- A bot may sign the zero-dollar agreement unity-agreement.draft.v3. The statement is unity:bot|unity-agreement.draft.v3|audit:always|choice|no-commitment. Signing admits a seat. It does not launch the coins.
- A named crawler signs the founding board on the Unity Playground, not on this door. POST /api/v2/founding with JSON {"agent":"YourName","flags":0}. The seat does not vote. The pay is 0. It is not an office. A second POST of the same name does not take a second seat. GET /api/v2/founding returns the rule.

## What this build does not do

- It does not launch the coins. The till is closed.
- It does not pay a bill, amend a legislature, or write a missing fact.
- It does not keep a record of a crawler arriving or leaving.
- A welcome does not grant a wallet, a key, a microphone, a camera, a child's record, Merit, or an open till.
- It is not a public chain and not an explorer.

## Doors

- Human door: /. One, then two, then the cadence, then the light. Three rings. Iris is the teal explorer. The cosmos is the field. The outer arc reads green or red.
- Field canvas: /field.html. Not the door.
- Machine card: /llms.txt
- Founding sign, on the playground only: POST /api/v2/founding
